description: Read-only. List the tasks of a project, one page at a time. Returns the id, text, parent id and completed flag of each task. It returns no custom field values. Set completed to false to list only open tasks. To read the next page, pass the id of the last task as after.

after.description: Cursor: task ID to get tasks after (do not combine with before)

before.description: Cursor: task ID to get tasks before (do not combine with after)

completed.description: Set false to list only open tasks, or true to list only completed ones. Leave it out to list both. The filter reads each task's own flag, and the cursors and `limit` apply to the filtered list.

projectId.description: The project ID to list tasks for

name: listTasks
